'''Tsoss Beacon''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Tsoss Beacon system/Legends|Tsoss Beacon system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], containing an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Communications relay/Legends|communications relay]] station built in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].

==History==
After being built in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the beacon would not be visited by an organic being for the next [[Standard year/Legends|fifteen years]].<ref name="Darksaber" />

During the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|post-Imperial era]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] called an assembly of thirteen Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], choosing the secluded asteroid base as their meeting spot. [[Sander Delvardus]], [[Blitzer Harrsk]], [[Treuten Teradoc]], [[Malfkla Yzu]], and other competing warlords agreed to meet to negotiate the [[Imperial Reunification|future]] of the forces and territories of the former Galactic Empire.<ref name="Darksaber" /> 

After [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of squabbling, it became clear to Daala that the warlords would never cooperate. She flooded the meeting room with poison gas, [[Death/Legends|executing]] the warlords, leaving herself and [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] as the only survivors.<ref name="Darksaber" />
